comment: The maturity and progress sections focus appropriately on architecture coverage, conformance, governance capability and outcomes. However, progress in infrastructure maturity- connectivity, exchange, security, access and platform coverage- may be mistaken for equivalent progress in how faithfully clinical and professional reality is represented. A system can exchange more data while still carrying incomplete or shallow meaning.

public.text: The maturity and progress sections focus appropriately on architecture coverage, conformance, governance capability and outcomes. However, progress in infrastructure maturity- connectivity, exchange, security, access and platform coverage- may be mistaken for equivalent progress in how faithfully clinical and professional reality is represented. public.suggestedRevision: Measure infrastructure maturity and representational maturity as related but distinct dimensions. In addition to component coverage and technical conformance, assess whether priority clinical content is complete, professionally validated, semantically faithful, linked across the care process, usable at the point of care, and preserved during secondary use. Avoid treating the existence of a platform, profile or data flow as evidence that the underlying professional meaning is adequate.
